sources.title: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next — Benchmarks, Specs & Release Date
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next Open Weight Released Aug 26 2026 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next is an AI model released by Qwen on Wednesday, Aug 26 2026, 12 days after Qwen3.8-27B. It is an open-weight model — the trained weights are available to download and run. It is a 125B parameter model with a 262k token context window. Benchmark results (shown below) cover JobBench, CoWorkBench, IFBench, Agent's Last Exam ...
